visual_enhancers.glow_effects: Use subtle radial gradients behind key charts or active Kanban columns to simulate ambient light. Example: bg-[radial-gradient(ellipse_at_top,_var(--tw-gradient-stops))] from-white/5 via-black/0 to-black/0
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid border-white/10 for all cards to give a technical, crisp edge.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Minimal drop shadows; rely on border contrast and glowing accents instead.

components.sidebar: Fixed left sidebar, bg-[#0A0A0A], border-r border-white/10. Links have a 2px left border on active state (neon accent).
components.topbar: Sticky top, h-16, backdrop-blur-md bg-black/50, border-b border-white/10. Contains global search (kbd shortcut UI) and user profile.
components.cards: bg-[#111111] rounded-xl border border-white/10 p-6. Hover states add a subtle -translate-y-1 and a glow or lighter border.
components.kanban_board: Columns are bg-white/5 rounded-xl border border-white/5. Cards inside are bg-[#181818] border border-white/10 with drag handles.
components.status_pills: Use flex, items-center, gap-2, px-2.5, py-1, rounded-full, text-xs, font-medium, border. Must feature a glowing 6px dot of the respective color.
components.tables: Minimalist. No vertical borders. border-b border-white/5 between rows. Header text is text-xs uppercase tracking-wider text-white/50.
components.inputs: bg-[#0A0A0A] border border-white/10 rounded-lg px-4 py-2 text-white focus:border-white/30 focus:ring-1 focus:ring-white/30 transition-all.
components.buttons: Primary: bg-white text-black font-medium hover:bg-neutral-200. Secondary: bg-white/5 text-white border border-white/10 hover:bg-white/10. Destructive: bg-[#FF3366]/10 text-[#FF3366] border border-[#FF3366]/20 hover:bg-[#FF3366]/20.

grids_and_layouts.dashboard: Bento-style dense layout. grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-6.
grids_and_layouts.spacing_scale: Use generous padding inside large containers (p-6, p-8) and tight grouping for related data (gap-1, gap-2).
grids_and_layouts.page_container: ml-64 (for sidebar), pt-16 (for topbar), max-w-[1600px] mx-auto p-8.

motion.page_transitions: Fade in with a slight upward translation (framer-motion opacity: 0 to 1, y: 10 to 0).
motion.stagger: List items and table rows should stagger in on load.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text against dark backgrounds passes WCAG AA or APCA standards. Muted text must still be readable.
accessibility.focus: All interactive elements must have visible focus states (e.g., focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-white/30).
accessibility.testing: Add data-testid attributes to all interactive elements.

media.icons: Use Phosphor Icons (@phosphor-icons/react) with duotone or thin weights to match the technical aesthetic.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the dashboard explicitly for a dark theme with `#050505` root background. Do not implement a light mode.
Use raw HTML/Tailwind for complex layout patterns to ensure precise control over grid overlaps.
Leverage Shadcn UI heavily but override backgrounds to dark grey/black and borders to `white/10`.
Do NOT use Inter or Roboto. Setup Cabinet Grotesk for headings and Satoshi for body (import via CDN/Google Fonts or Fontshare in index.html).
Incorporate the neon status colors exactly as specified for all asset status badges.
Ensure the sidebar is persistent and the topbar contains a global search input.
Implement the Kanban board using a robust drag-and-drop approach, styling it with subtle column backgrounds.
Include an 'Overdue' banner on the Dashboard with the neon red color `#FF3366`.
No generic rounded SaaS cards with heavy shadows; use crisp borders (rounded-xl is fine, but focus on the 1px stroke).
Use `lucide-react` with thin stroke width, as it's typically default in Shadcn. Or install Phosphor.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g. `data-testid="login-button"`).
Write code in .js files as specified. Do NOT use .tsx.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and 1px semi-transparent borders.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) for sticky headers and overlays.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., `transition: all`). Always add transitions for specific properties.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, i.e., do not add `.App { text-align: center; }` in the CSS file.
Always use modern button styles (sharp or rounded) with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc. for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable inside large containers.
Use the provided image URLs. Missing categories = you will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN.
Create new components that match the style and conventions of existing components when needed.
